original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方逮捕32岁连环手机盗窃嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方逮捕一名32岁嫌疑人Ifeanyi Obi，据称其与Awka、Isuaniocha和Mgbakwu等地酒店多起手机盗窃案有关。警方称，此次逮捕是在调查相关报案并审查监控录像后实施的。据称嫌疑人在审讯中承认从涉事社区酒店盗走五部安卓手机。该信息目前仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Anambra State, hotels in Awka, Isuaniocha and Mgbakwu communities

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州警方逮捕一名32岁疑似连环手机盗窃嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Anambra State Police Command has arrested a 32-year-old suspected serial mobile phone thief, identified as Ifeanyi Obi

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指与Awka、Isuaniocha和Mgbakwu社区酒店多起手机盗窃案有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in connection with multiple cases of mobile phone theft at hotels in Awka, Isuaniocha and Mgbakwu communities in the state

key_facts.fact: 警方称逮捕依据是调查和监控录像审查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the arrest followed investigations into reported cases of mobile phone theft and a review of video surveillance footage allegedly linking the suspect to the incidents

key_facts.fact: 据称嫌疑人在审讯中承认盗走五部安卓手机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: during interrogation, the suspect reportedly confessed to stealing five Android phones from hotels in the affected communities

uncertainties: 嫌疑人身份及作案细节尚未经独立来源证实
嫌疑人供述内容为据称，尚未获法院确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道
